subject: Oceanography
title: Continental Shelves
description: A short lesson to help you apply Continental Shelves.

hook.text: The ocean isn't deep everywhere—near coastlines, it's often shallow enough for sunlight to reach the bottom.

buildup.text: Continental shelves are underwater extensions of the continent, sloping gently to about 200 meters depth.

discovery.text: Though shelves cover only 8% of the ocean, they host most commercial fisheries and coral reefs.

twist.text: During ice ages, sea level dropped and shelves were exposed—humans walked across many of them.

climax.text: At the shelf edge, the continental slope plunges steeply toward the deep ocean floor.

punchline.text: The richest ocean zone is the shallowest one.

quiz.question: How deep do continental shelves typically extend?
